name: Slice of cake
summary: Triangular slice of layered sponge, cream and jam with a strawberry on top, on a small plate, for dessert scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the plate rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~420 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = small rock, pop = scale in with overshoot
